note: All files listed here are real third-party data. species_profile_prunus_serotina.json is a hand-written summary of LANUK pages (see its sources).

bonn_districts.title: Statistische Bezirke Bonn
bonn_districts.used_for: Bonn boundary (ingest filter) and district/Stadtbezirk names for reports
bonn_districts.processing: Douglas-Peucker 1 m, coordinates rounded to 6 decimals; Stadtbezirk derived from first digit of district code

bonn_wooded_landuse.title: Landnutzungskartierung Realnutzung — wooded classes
bonn_wooded_landuse.used_for: Forest / wooded urban green mask; land-use class shown to reviewers; simulator survey areas
bonn_wooded_landuse.processing: Kept classes 2600 Wald, 2645, 2670, 2680, 2475 (with trees); Douglas-Peucker 1.5 m

lanuk_nsg.title: Naturschutzgebiete (NSG) in Bonn
lanuk_nsg.used_for: Context flag 'inside / near nature reserve' (LANUK prioritisation criterion)
lanuk_nsg.processing: Kept features with Bonn identifiers (BN-*); Douglas-Peucker 1 m; protection goal truncated

lanuk_ffh.title: FFH-Gebiete (Natura 2000) intersecting Bonn
lanuk_ffh.used_for: Context flag 'inside / near FFH site'; habitat types shown to reviewers
lanuk_ffh.processing: Kept sites intersecting Bonn except DE-4405-301 (Rhine fish zones); Douglas-Peucker 2 m

lanuk_protected_biotopes.title: Gesetzlich geschützte Biotope (§30 BNatSchG / §42 LNatSchG NRW) in Bonn
lanuk_protected_biotopes.license: Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero – 2.0 (dl-de/zero-2-0) — assumed same as other LINFOS layers; confirm with LANUK
lanuk_protected_biotopes.used_for: Context flag 'inside / near protected biotope' (LANUK prioritisation criterion)
lanuk_protected_biotopes.processing: Kept polygons whose bbox centre lies in Bonn; Douglas-Peucker 1 m

gbif_prunus_serotina.title: GBIF occurrences of Prunus serotina within Bonn
gbif_prunus_serotina.publisher: GBIF.org (aggregating iNaturalist, Pl@ntNet, observation.org, NABU|naturgucker, floristic mapping, herbaria)
gbif_prunus_serotina.download_url: https://api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/search (taxonKey=3021850, Bonn bbox, filtered to city boundary)
gbif_prunus_serotina.license: Per record: CC0 / CC BY 4.0 / CC BY-NC 4.0 (see each feature). Cite as GBIF.org occurrence search.
gbif_prunus_serotina.used_for: Context only: 'external records nearby' shown to reviewers, with dataset, accuracy and ID method
gbif_prunus_serotina.processing: Observer names dropped; records outside Bonn boundary dropped

lanuk_neobiota.title: LANUK Neobiota portal — public validated find points for Prunus serotina
lanuk_neobiota.license: Not stated on the service — used only as a count and as a field vocabulary; confirm terms with LANUK
lanuk_neobiota.used_for: Shows how many LANUK-validated points exist in Bonn; field vocabulary for the report draft export
lanuk_neobiota.processing: Queried all NRW records for the species; counted those inside Bonn; collected distinct values of plant fields
